findings.summary: gatekeeperCostLedger.ts:67 nonNegative() uses n > 0 instead of n >= 0, rejecting zero which is a valid nonnegative value; no practical impact since 0 tokens produce 0 cost regardless. Fix: change n > 0 to n >= 0. Source write blocked by permission (3 attempts across 3 runs).

gatekeeperBridge.ts:180 Unicode reordering character stripping uses raw Unicode codepoints instead of \uXXXX escape sequences; correct behavior but fragile under re-encoding. Fix: replace regex with /[\u200E\u200F\u061C\u202A-\u202E\u2066-\u2069]/g. Source write blocked by permission (3 attempts across 3 runs).

degradedMode.ts:835 git parent-count parsing via split/filter chain could miscount on unexpected whitespace; fix: split into named parentParts variable, guard parentParts.length > 0 before subtracting 1, else -1. Source write blocked by permission (3 attempts across 3 runs).

gatekeeperTransport.ts:213-233 recursive descriptor walk has depth limit but no cycle detection; fix: add visited Set<object>, check and add before recursing. Source write blocked by permission (3 attempts across 3 runs).
degradedMode.ts at 903 lines exceeds 800-line guideline; authority-wrapper functions (lines 804-903) could extract to degradedModeAuthority.ts. Source write blocked by permission.
Prompt injection across model boundary: BLOCKED by closed vocabulary, identifier-only bridge args, strict JSON schema with additionalProperties:false, and sanitized refusal text
Evidence poisoning via nextClaudeInstruction: BLOCKED by control-char stripping, truncation, bidi-reorder removal, and strict schema enforcement
Cross-project leakage: BLOCKED by set-level isolation check in gatekeeperThread.ts detecting shared threads or roots across projects
Stale decision replay: BLOCKED by consumedAt tracking and alreadyConsumedDecisionIds set; duplicate calls after restart prevented by deterministic requestId derivation and ledger deduplication
Subject drift: BLOCKED by decision bound to exact subject commit in digest
Credential leakage: BLOCKED by closure-scoped access pattern in credentialResolver; secret never logged, returned, or stored; secret-shape detection prevents config leaks
Cost runaway and model escalation: BLOCKED by integer micro-USD ledger, deterministic ask-to-tier mapping, per-phase/project/monthly budget with hard stop, no auto-recharge
Self-approval: BLOCKED by gatekeeper being remote (never the implementer); explicit check at gatekeeperDecision.ts:262

Degraded-mode escalation and override replay: BLOCKED by owner-only action refusal, consumed tracking, scope limits, max work items, reconciliation gate blocking major gates until unreviewed work cleared
Bridge authority bypass: BLOCKED by exact-name vocabulary for operations, provenance field denylist (case-insensitive), no deploy/database/shell/payment/credential/sign operations in bridge surface

openaiResponses.ts:232 credential.use() callback relies on HTTP port timeout (config.timeoutMs, default 120s) to bound secret lifetime in closure. credential.use() is synchronous (<T>(fn) => T), so secret released when http.post returns. HTTP port contract must honour timeoutMs. Verified mitigated by existing design.
